# PPU instruction encodings

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen_ppu_docs.py from live ppuasm and ppudisasm runs: do not edit by hand. -->

Every PPU instruction is one 16-bit word, written big-endian: a 4-bit opcode and 12 operand bits. Each row is a form `ppuasm` accepts, with the word it assembles to, split as `oooo xxxxxxxxxxxx`, and what `ppudisasm` prints for that word. What each instruction does is in [instruction-set.md](instruction-set.md).

## Basic instructions (opcodes 0-D)

| Form | Word | `oooo xxxxxxxxxxxx` | Disassembles as |
|------|------|--------------------|-----------------|
| `DEFCALL R3, R4` | `00C4` | `0000 000011000100` | `DEFCALL R3, R4` |
| `MOVXP R5` | `1005` | `0001 000000000101` | `MOVXP R5` |
| `NOP` | `1800` | `0001 100000000000` | `NOP` |
| `SWAPREG R1, R2` | `2042` | `0010 000001000010` | `SWAPREG R1, R2` |
| `CLR R5` | `3005` | `0011 000000000101` | `CLR R5` |
| `CMP R1, R2` | `4042` | `0100 000001000010` | `CMP R1, R2` |
| `CLRF` | `5000` | `0101 000000000000` | `CLRF` |
| `JMZ` | `6000` | `0110 000000000000` | `JMZ` |
| `JMG` | `6800` | `0110 100000000000` | `JMG` |
| `JNZ` | `7000` | `0111 000000000000` | `JNZ` |
| `JNG` | `7800` | `0111 100000000000` | `JNG` |
| `INC R5` | `8005` | `1000 000000000101` | `INC R5` |
| `DEC R5` | `9005` | `1001 000000000101` | `DEC R5` |
| `ADD R1, R2` | `A042` | `1010 000001000010` | `ADD R1, R2` |
| `SUB R1, R2` | `B042` | `1011 000001000010` | `SUB R1, R2` |
| `MUL R1, R2` | `C042` | `1100 000001000010` | `MUL R1, R2` |
| `INTDIV R1, R2` | `D042` | `1101 000001000010` | `INTDIV R1, R2` |

## Preset E (opcode E)

| Form | Word | `oooo xxxxxxxxxxxx` | Disassembles as |
|------|------|--------------------|-----------------|
| `TARREG 2, LSB, R5` | `E205` | `1110 001000000101` | `TARREG 2, LSB, R5` |
| `TARREG 3, MSB, R5` | `E385` | `1110 001110000101` | `TARREG 3, MSB, R5` |
| `SETBYTE 2, 0x7F` | `E67F` | `1110 011001111111` | `SETBYTE 2, $7F` |
| `BUILD 2, 3, R5` | `EAC5` | `1110 101011000101` | `BUILD 2, 3, R5` |
| `CPREG R1, R2` | `EC12` | `1110 110000010010` | `CPREG R1, R2` |

## Preset F (opcode F)

| Form | Word | `oooo xxxxxxxxxxxx` | Disassembles as |
|------|------|--------------------|-----------------|
| `SETPOS R1, R2` | `F012` | `1111 000000010010` | `SETPOS R1, R2` |
| `SETTILE R1, 0` | `F104` | `1111 000100000100` | `SETTILE R1, 0` |
| `SETTILE R1, 3` | `F107` | `1111 000100000111` | `SETTILE R1, 3` |
| `SETDP R7` | `F21C` | `1111 001000011100` | `SETDP R7` |
| `MOVDP R5` | `F314` | `1111 001100010100` | `MOVDP R5` |
| `SETRENDMOD 0` | `F400` | `1111 010000000000` | `SETRENDMOD 0` |
| `SETRENDMOD 1` | `F480` | `1111 010010000000` | `SETRENDMOD 1` |
| `PALETTE16` | `F500` | `1111 010100000000` | `PALETTE16` |
| `PALETTE256` | `F600` | `1111 011000000000` | `PALETTE256` |
| `JMR` | `F700` | `1111 011100000000` | `JMR` |
| `MOV R5` | `F814` | `1111 100000010100` | `MOV R5` |
| `SETREGBANK 1, 2` | `F918` | `1111 100100011000` | `SETREGBANK 1, 2` |
| `CLRTILE` | `FA00` | `1111 101000000000` | `CLRTILE` |
| `CLRPALETTE` | `FB00` | `1111 101100000000` | `CLRPALETTE` |
| `TILEDRAW` | `FC00` | `1111 110000000000` | `TILEDRAW` |
| `SETTILEBANK R3` | `FD0C` | `1111 110100001100` | `SETTILEBANK R3` |
| `CALL 5` | `FE05` | `1111 111000000101` | `CALL $05` |
| `GBLS R5` | `FF14` | `1111 111100010100` | `GBLS R5` |

## Assembler shorthands

These are not instructions: the assembler expands each into the real instructions below. Everything that jumps to a label uses **target registers 0 and 1**, overwriting them ([assembler.md](assembler.md)). `target` is a label on the line after the shorthand, so the addresses are small.

**`JMR target`** (10 bytes)

```text
TARREG 0, LSB, R62
TARREG 1, MSB, R62
SETBYTE 0, $0A
SETBYTE 1, $00
JMR
```

**`JMZ target`** (10 bytes)

```text
TARREG 0, LSB, R62
TARREG 1, MSB, R62
SETBYTE 0, $0A
SETBYTE 1, $00
JMZ
```

**`JNZ target`** (10 bytes)

```text
TARREG 0, LSB, R62
TARREG 1, MSB, R62
SETBYTE 0, $0A
SETBYTE 1, $00
JNZ
```

**`JMG target`** (10 bytes)

```text
TARREG 0, LSB, R62
TARREG 1, MSB, R62
SETBYTE 0, $0A
SETBYTE 1, $00
JMG
```

**`JNG target`** (10 bytes)

```text
TARREG 0, LSB, R62
TARREG 1, MSB, R62
SETBYTE 0, $0A
SETBYTE 1, $00
JNG
```

**`PUSH R5`** (8 bytes)

```text
INC R61
INC R61
SETDP R61
MOVDP R5
```

**`POP R5`** (8 bytes)

```text
SETDP R61
DEC R61
DEC R61
MOV R5
```

**`JSR target`** (26 bytes)

```text
TARREG 0, LSB, R62
TARREG 1, MSB, R62
SETBYTE 0, $1A
SETBYTE 1, $00
INC R61
INC R61
SETDP R61
MOVDP R62
TARREG 0, LSB, R62
TARREG 1, MSB, R62
SETBYTE 0, $1A
SETBYTE 1, $00
JMR
```

**`RET`** (10 bytes)

```text
SETDP R61
DEC R61
DEC R61
MOV R62
JMR
```

**`HLT`** (10 bytes)

```text
TARREG 0, LSB, R62
TARREG 1, MSB, R62
SETBYTE 0, $00
SETBYTE 1, $00
JMR
```
